desc: Ideate approach: per-vitamin calorie knapsack DPs plus binary search feasibility.
Implement complete Python solution: parse input, group foods by vitamin, compute three capacity DPs, binary search maximum feasible target, handle empty groups, print answer.
Verify DP arrays are nondecreasing and feasibility uses minimum calorie budget for each target.
Test edge cases: missing vitamin types, answer 0, large vitamin values, all foods too expensive to combine.
